title: Knitted fabric in five stitch patterns
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of knitted fabric: stockinette Vs, purl bumps, garter ridges, k2p2 rib or seed stitch, with twisted plies, fuzz and optional stripes or a stranded two-colour motif. Use for jumpers, scarves, hats, blankets and cosy props.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python knit_stockinette.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.meaning: 0 stockinette (all knit), 1 reverse stockinette (all purl), 2 garter (knit and purl rows alternate), 3 k2p2 rib (two knit columns, two purl columns), 4 seed stitch (knit and purl alternate in both directions).

parameters.name: stitches
parameters.meaning: Stitch columns across the tile width; rounded up to a multiple of 4 for rib and of 8 for a motif.

parameters.name: row_ratio
parameters.meaning: Rows per stitch width (the gauge); the row count is rounded to keep the pattern repeating.

parameters.name: yarn_width
parameters.meaning: Yarn thickness relative to the stitch: low values open gaps between the legs.

parameters.name: twist
parameters.meaning: Depth of the diagonal grooves between twisted plies.

parameters.name: plies
parameters.meaning: Ply twists along one stitch leg.

parameters.name: fuzz
parameters.meaning: Fibre halo: fine noise in height and colour, and rougher yarn.

parameters.name: irregularity
parameters.meaning: Hand-knit unevenness: per-stitch offset, size and tone.

parameters.name: colourwork
parameters.meaning: 0 one colour, 1 contrast stripes two rows in six, 2 a stranded two-colour motif repeating every eight stitches and rows.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Cream wool in stockinette, a fine jumper knit.

presets.name: chunky_red
presets.description: Thick red yarn in stockinette with strongly twisted plies.

presets.name: navy_rib
presets.description: Navy k2p2 ribbing as on cuffs and hems, the purl columns sunk between the knit.

presets.name: heather_garter
presets.description: Grey heather yarn in garter stitch: ridges of purl bumps.

presets.name: fair_isle
presets.description: Stranded colourwork: a navy motif on cream stockinette.

presets.name: moss_seed
presets.description: Moss green seed stitch with a pebbly surface and contrast stripes.

limits: Stitches are stylized yarn domes on a regular grid: knit legs are superellipses and a purl stitch is a cosine-shaped yarn path, not a simulated loop structure. Cables, increases, decreases and lace holes are out of scope, and the stranded motif is a symmetric 8 x 8 chart chosen by the seed. The fabric is flat, with no drape or stretch. Ply grooves fade out where they would be finer than a few pixels. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced. Colours are artistic, not measured yarn.
technique_references: Stitch grid in texture space with whole stitch and row counts
Knit stitch legs as tilted superellipse domes, z-ordered against neighbouring rows
Purl yarn path as a cosine wave with half-stitch row offsets
Ply twist as grooves along the leg axis
Mirror-symmetric two-colour chart for stranded colourwork
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
